reports.title: Peabody Reports Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: •Volume is expected to be 3.6—3.8 million tons, including 2.5—2.7 million export tons. ~1.6 million tons of Newcastle product and ~0.8 million tons of high ash product are unpriced. Costs are anticipated to be $46—$51 per ton.
